entries.description: UK software development and IT consultancy: AI agent readiness (A2A, AP2, UCP, MCP, Knowledge Catalog). The readiness review, UCP, Knowledge Catalog, A2A, AP2, MCP and systems architecture are a custom quote. The agent-readiness scan is free. Heimdell TPV (third-party verification) and telecom compliance guides now live at https://telecomcompliance.uk/. Also answers questions about Business Technology MOTs from £99, on-site IT troubleshooting from £65/hour and scoped monthly maintenance from £79 in Preston/Lancashire.
